title: ETL, ELT & Data Pipeline (ETL, ELT, and Data Pipelines)
lead: Menganalisis kebutuhan integrasi data. Merancang alur ETL/ELT dan pipeline yang efisien. Mengevaluasi rancangan dari sisi kualitas data & kinerja.

sections.label: ETL, ELT, and Data Pipelines
sections.title: 1. ETL vs ELT
body: ETL: Transform sebelum Load (cocok untuk warehouse klasik + aturan ketat). ELT: Load mentah dulu ke lake/warehouse lalu Transform di dalam (cocok untuk big data + fleksibilitas, mis. dbt di BigQuery/Snowflake). Pola medallion: Bronze (mentah) → Silver (bersih) → Gold (agregat bisnis).
sections.callout: Bahan Bacaan: Reis & Housley (2022) Ch.8-10; Doan et al. (2012) Ch.5-6

sections.label: ETL, ELT, and Data Pipelines
sections.title: 2. Anatomi Pipeline
body: Ingest → Validate (Great Expectations: not-null, unique, range) → Transform (idempotent!) → Load (upsert/merge, SCD) → Orchestrate (Airflow/Prefect: retry, SLA, alerting) → Observe (data docs, freshness, volume, lineage dengan OpenLineage).

sections.label: ETL, ELT, and Data Pipelines
sections.title: 3. Kualitas & Kinerja
body: Idempotensi: rerun aman. Incremental vs full load (watermark). Partisi berdasarkan tanggal. Evaluasi: data quality gates lolos? SLA terpenuhi? biaya compute? RPO/RTO backup?
sections.callout: Istilah Kunci: ETL vs ELT, Medallion, Idempotent, Orchestration, Data observability

sections.label: Implementasi Praktis
sections.title: Contoh Kode & Query
body: Berikut adalah contoh kode atau kueri terkait topik modul ini:
sections.callout:
-- Contoh ELT: transform di dalam warehouse (dbt-style)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW gold.daily_revenue AS
SELECT d.year, d.month, SUM(f.amount) AS revenue
FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key)
GROUP BY 1, 2;

quiz.question: Perbedaan ETL vs ELT…
options: ETL transform sebelum load; ELT load mentah dulu lalu transform di platform target

quiz.question: Lapisan 'Silver' pada medallion…
quiz.explanation: Bronze mentah → Silver bersih → Gold bisnis.

quiz.question: Sifat pipeline yang aman di-rerun disebut…
Contoh data quality gate…
options: Cek not-null, unique, range sebelum load
quiz.explanation: Validasi dengan Great Expectations / dbt tests.
